blocks.title: Enzymes
blocks.text: Enzymes proteins hain jo jaandaron mein hone wale mukhtalif chemical reactions ke liye biological catalysts (reaction ko tez karne wale, khud kharch na hone wale maadde) ka kaam karte hain.

Enzyme biochemical reaction ko itna tez kar deta hai jitna us ke baghair mumkin hi nahi. Maslan khoon mein carbonic anhydrase enzyme ka sirf aik molecule taqreeban das lakh (one million) carbon dioxide aur paani ke molecules ko carbonic acid mein badal deta hai, aur yeh kaam aik second mein hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke yeh das lakh molecules 'aik minute' mein badalte hain. Napi gayi raftaar is se kaheen zyada hai: taqreeban das lakh (10⁶) molecules har second. Is liye yahan 'aik second' likha gaya hai.
Enzyme ki satah (surface) par aik khaas jagah hoti hai jise active site kehte hain. Yeh substrate (woh molecule jis par enzyme kaam karta hai) ko pakar kar products mein badal deti hai.

blocks.alt: Laal substrate jis ke neeche teen nokein hain, neele enzyme ke oopar hai jis mein waisa hi zigzag kataao, active site, hai. Teer enzyme-substrate complex tak jata hai jis mein substrate active site mein theek baith jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.7: Enzyme-substrate complex ka banna (kitab ki Figure 27.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Laal substrate ka neeche wala kinara enzyme ki active site ke kate hue hisse mein bilkul fit hota hai, jaise chaabi taale mein. Dono mil kar enzyme-substrate complex banate hain.

Enzymes bohat specific (makhsoos) hote hain: har enzyme sirf aik khaas substrate par kaam karta hai. Is ki wajah active site hai, jis ki anokhi shakal mein sirf wahi substrate fit hota hai. Enzyme aur substrate molecules ki be-tarteeb harkat se substrate active site mein dakhil hota hai aur aik aarzi (temporary) enzyme–substrate complex banta hai. Phir products nikal jate hain aur enzyme bilkul waisa hi rehta hai, aur agle substrate molecule se jurne ke liye azad hota hai (Figure 27.7).

Yeh tareeqa Emil Fischer ke 1894 mein pesh kiye gaye lock and key model se samjha ja sakta hai. Is model mein enzyme taala (lock) aur substrate chaabi (key) hai. Sirf sahi shakal wali chaabi (substrate) taale (enzyme) ke surakh (active site) mein fit hoti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Enzymes hazme (digestion) mein bhi yahi kaam karte hain: hazme ke enzymes khurak ke bare molecules, jaise starch, proteins aur fats, ko chhote molecules mein tor dete hain jinhein jism jazb kar sake.

blocks.prompt: Enzyme sirf aik substrate par kyun kaam karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ki active site ki shakal anokhi hai jis mein sirf wahi substrate fit hota hai, jaisa lock and key model mein.

items: Enzymes protein catalysts hain; substrate active site se jurta hai.
Enzyme-substrate complex → products; enzyme be-tabdeel rehta hai.
Lock and key model (Emil Fischer, 1894): enzyme taala, substrate chaabi.
